Outline now sized by the pin perimeter, two pin layers per dense face: E face e_v+e_d = 2,052 pins on M2+M4 (pin_h, precedent dsfd_hrow_r2079_m5 CLOSED at 2,079 pins / 129.6 um on M2 M4) -> 2,052/(2 x 8 pins/um/layer) = 128.3 um min, quantised up to 172.8 um (8 x 21.6) = 5.94 pins/um/layer for PPL section margin and the recipe-2 hold/flop band; N face s_v+s_d+r_bad = 1,028 pins on M3+M5 (pin_v) -> 1,028/(2 x 8) = 64.3 um min -> 86.4 um (4 x 21.6) = 5.95 pins/um/layer. Gate trial a (129.6x151.2, N on M5 only = 7.93 pins/um, util 17%): TT insertion 198.9 ps / spread 27.9 ps but the W ~40% of the core stayed empty (logic follows the E/N pin flops) -> width cut to 86.4. Route a77910722 (86.4x151.2, PPL ordered 32-pin groups) EARLY_FAIL GRT-0116: mild overflow (max 4/18 per gcell, total 2,016) only in the E/N hold-stage bands -- PPL packs groups at slot pitch and stacks both layers locally (~20 pins/um peak, gaps elsewhere). Fix: route.pin_balance (uniform place_pin, layer alternating every pin: E 2,052/172.8 = 11.9 pins/um face, N 1,028/86.4 = 11.9 pins/um face, <= 6 per layer) and E height 172.8. W pins in explicit centre pin_ranges (ck at 86.0-86.8 = face centre, rn adjacent). Outline 86.4x172.8 = 14,930 um2 (r2 62,986 um2, -76%), expected util ~23%, still pin-limited. Clock + rn stay at the W-face centre: in an 86.4 um wide tile the W centre is 86.4 um from the E pin column and <= 173 um Manhattan from any sink (r2: up to ~356 um); never a corner. tq[1] sync-clear fan-out (~4.1k loads on r_q/pad) left in RTL (frozen, proven source); buffered by repair_design.
